body.title: End-to-end smoke validation on the captured fixture
body.summary: Prove the user-visible outcome on the two least-evidenced paths with real binaries. Add the smoke suite: spawn the real daemon against a temp ~/.insrc seeded with a scratch copy of the t2 legacy fixture, assert the file is normalized, that all three dynamic namespaces are byte-identical to the baseline, and that the daemon serves IPC; then boot a second time against the now-normalized file and assert zero writes (mtime unchanged) — the convergence property that makes an unconditional boot reconcile safe. Separately, boot once against an empty temp home and diff the written document against the t2 captured pre-change defaults literal to confirm first-boot output is unchanged for every key that literal covered. Then run an actual update against a scratch copy and diff the result against the pre-change capture: the newly-catalogued key added, the type-invalid key repaired, every dynamic namespace unchanged, and a second run writing nothing. No INSRC_LIVE_TESTS gate is needed — neither Ollama nor CliProvider is touched.
acceptanceChecks: A daemon spawned against the temp legacy home normalizes the config, serves IPC, and leaves models.analyze.roleTiers, models.analyze.byRepo and models.agents byte-identical to the t2 baseline
A second boot against the normalized file performs zero writes and leaves mtime unchanged
A first boot against an empty temp home produces values identical to the t2 captured pre-change defaults literal for every key that literal covered
An update run against a scratch copy of the fixture adds the missing catalog key, repairs the type-invalid one, leaves every dynamic namespace unchanged, and a repeat run writes nothing
The smoke suite runs under `npx tsx --test` without an INSRC_LIVE_TESTS gate
The full sweep `npx tsx --test 'src/**/__tests__/*.test.ts'` passes and `npm run build` is clean

tests.name: real daemon boot against a temp ~/.insrc holding the legacy fixture — file normalized, all three dynamic namespaces byte-identical to the baseline, daemon serves IPC
second real boot against the now-normalized file — zero writes, mtime unchanged (convergence)
first real boot against an empty temp home — written values identical to the t2 captured pre-change defaults literal for every key it covered
real update run against a scratch fixture copy — missing catalog key added, type-invalid key repaired, dynamic namespaces unchanged, repeat run writes nothing
